compiled_state.title: Tighten the review-gate allowlist (docs/skills reviewable; two-file edit)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
As a maintainer, I want behavior-bearing instruction surfaces (docs/**, skills, behavior-driving config) to be reviewable so that an un-reviewed instruction surface — an attack vector in an agentic codebase — cannot ride to main via the allowlist.

Plan refs: A-4.6 (allowlist tightening); §2.9/§2.10 (two-file edit). Contributor-facing change (this repo's own doc edits now need review) — ship carefully and communicate.

DONE DEFINITION:
- DD1: review-gate-allowlist.conf is tightened — remove docs/**, skills, .claude/docs/**, .semgrep.yml, .pre-commit-config.yaml, .claude/scripts/** from the skip set; KEEP only genuinely-inert artifacts (images, lockfiles, generated) AND the event-sourced ticket store (.tickets-tracker tree). (SC5)
- DD2: TWO-FILE edit — also strip the hardcoded :!docs/** and :!.claude/docs/** from compute-diff-hash.sh _FALLBACK_PATHSPECS (the degradation else-branch) so the degraded path matches the tightened normal path. (SC5)
- DD3: assert-review-liveness.sh skip-stub acceptance still fail-closes for the newly-reviewable docs/config paths (TS-1 revalidation). (SC2/SC5)
- DD4: re-baseline the affected tests (test-review-gate-allowlist.sh, test-behavioral-equivalence-allowlist.sh, test-skip-review-check.sh, test-review-gate-config-doc-dirs.sh, test-compute-diff-hash-tickets*.sh, check-allowlist-correctness.sh probe set).

LIVE VERIFICATION + EXPERIMENTS:
- E11: a docs-only PR now yields code_changed=true (requires review); an image/lockfile-only PR still skips.
- E-compute-hash: feed an identical file list incl docs/foo.md to skip-review-check.sh AND compute-diff-hash.sh -> both classify docs as reviewable (consumers in sync).
- Live: open a throwaway docs-only PR2 -> review actually runs (not skip-to-success).

COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: if tightening makes the project's own routine doc/config edits painfully slow or wedges legitimate doc PRs, reassess the allowlist scope (keep genuinely-inert patterns) before story 7 — do not ship a contributor-hostile gate.

Maps to SC5. DEPENDS ON story 5 (review-gate must exist to enforce the tightened classification).
